headline: Seahawks 13, Patriots 10: three Maye interceptions, a Super Bowl rematch that stayed ugly
whyCareReason: The opener was the Super Bowl again. New England led 10-0. Seattle scored the last 13 and left with the first win of 2026.
teaser: FINAL: Seahawks 13, Patriots 10. Darnold left injured. Drew Lock finished it. Maye threw three fourth-quarter interceptions.
story:
Why this one matters: Super Bowl LX was 29-13 Seattle in February. The rematch on 9 September was 13-10, and it was not pretty.

ESPN: Patriots 0-7-3-0, Seahawks 0-0-3-10. New England led 10-0 through the middle of the third. Seattle scored 13 unanswered. Sam Darnold left injured. Drew Lock came in and threw for 187 yards. Drake Maye threw three interceptions. Jaxon Smith-Njigba had 122 receiving yards. Jadarian Price led Seattle with 52 rushing yards.

Sporting News and ESPN agree on 13-10. Wikipedia's 2026 season page lists Seattle as the Kickoff Game winner. The Dark Side defence, not the Super Bowl offence, won the night.
stakes: Week 1, a Super Bowl rematch, the first result of 2026.
rivalryAngle: Seattle 29-13 in February. Seattle 13-10 in September. New England still looking for the reply.
